title: 人山人海

lines.text: 国庆节放七天假，王明和小雨决定找一天，去城外的八达岭爬长城。
lines.py: guó qìng jié fàng qī tiān jiǎ, Wáng Míng hé Xiǎo yǔ jué dìng zhǎo yì tiān, qù chéng wài de bā dá lǐng pá cháng chéng.
lines.en: There's a seven-day holiday for National Day, and Wang Ming and Xiaoyu decide to spend one of the days climbing the Great Wall at Badaling, outside the city.
